t: Interactive demos that show how an agent learns by rewards on a grid map.
steps: Open the AI4K12 page for the Gridworld demos.
Choose Imaginary AI for the first lesson.
Open the demo link in a browser.
Try the map yourself before class.
Ask IT to confirm the external sites are open.
Have students edit one reward and watch the result.
Use TDDemo for a second lesson on stochastic actions.
